info.title: KAVACH API
info.description: Risk, Fraud and Regulatory Intelligence Copilot for Indian Banking

get.description: Health check endpoint

Today dashboard: readiness score (with the factors pulling it down), KPIs,
the five things needing attention, a 30-day alerts vs confirmed-fraud trend
and a one-paragraph weekly brief. Deadlines use the data's as-of date.

The signed-in identity. The role is the Snowflake session's CURRENT_ROLE(), so the
UI's read-only mode matches what masking and row-access policies actually enforce.
`as_of` is the data's "today" used for report deadlines.

List alerts with optional filters. `priority` puts open alerts first, then the
nearest report deadline, then severity.
